description: This file manages Telegram thread bindings, including creation, persistence, expiration, and cleanup. It defines types, manages shared state, and provides functions for binding conversations to sessions, updating, and resetting bindings, with support for asynchronous disk operations and interval-based cleanup.

classes.name: TelegramThreadBindingRecord
classes.description: Represents a binding between a Telegram conversation and a session, including metadata such as agent ID, labels, activity timestamps, and optional timeout settings.

classes.name: TelegramThreadBindingManager
classes.description: Manages a set of Telegram thread bindings for a specific account, including creation, lookup, updating, expiration, and persistence.

methods.name: createTelegramThreadBindingManager
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new Telegram thread binding manager for a given account, loading existing bindings from disk and setting up cleanup intervals.

methods.name: getTelegramThreadBindingManager
methods.description: Retrieves the existing Telegram thread binding manager for a specified account.

methods.name: setTelegramThreadBindingIdleTimeoutBySessionKey
methods.description: Updates the idle timeout for all bindings associated with a specific session key.

methods.name: setTelegramThreadBindingMaxAgeBySessionKey
methods.description: Updates the maximum age for all bindings associated with a specific session key.

methods.name: resetTelegramThreadBindingsForTests
methods.description: Stops all managers and clears all bindings, used for testing purposes.
